title: ARWP Production Search Build Gate
purpose: Prove that the final publish artifact and the deployed Search-facing representation agree on the bounded release contract without treating repository state, a successful build, or a deployment badge as equivalent evidence.

rules.claim: The publish artifact, not an earlier source/template state, is the release boundary for static publication.
rules.decision: Require an artifact-root index.html and reject unsafe/symlinked or unbounded artifact inventories.

rules.claim: Sitemaps should contain canonical URLs that the site actually intends to expose, not missing, redirected, error or foreign-host URLs.
rules.decision: When a root sitemap exists, use it as the canonical index cohort and require every listed URL to resolve to an artifact HTML page.

rules.claim: Final index-candidate HTML must not contradict its own title, canonical, robots, JSON-LD or Open Graph URL signals.
rules.decision: Fail the artifact gate on missing/duplicate canonical or title, unexpected noindex, invalid JSON-LD anywhere in the document, off-site canonical, canonical-route mismatch or conflicting og:url.

rules.claim: A static error document must not present itself as canonical content.
rules.decision: Reject canonical declarations on 404 artifacts; keep missing noindex as review evidence because the serving HTTP status remains separate runtime evidence.

rules.claim: A correct local artifact does not prove the deployed Search-facing representation is the same artifact.
rules.decision: Compare live title, description, canonical, noindex, og:url and JSON-LD parse state, block count and normalized semantic fingerprints with the final artifact; optionally require byte parity for hosts where exact delivery is expected.

rules.claim: Deployment success is revision-specific evidence; a green deployment for another commit is not proof for the intended source revision.
rules.decision: Compare explicit source and deployed 40-character commit SHAs when both are available; missing revision evidence remains watch rather than pass.
